metadata.methods_description: Simultaneous EEG-ESG-ENG-EMG recordings were acquired from 40 participants under four conditions: resting state (eyes open), mixed median nerve stimulation (arm), mixed tibial nerve stimulation (leg), and alternating mixed nerve stimulation. Recordings included electrocardiographic and respiratory signals. ESG electrode positions are provided for each participant. The EEG channel Fz was referenced to both the EEG reference (right mastoid, RM) and the ESG reference (6th thoracic vertebra, TH6). This study was pre-registered on OSF: https://osf.io/sgptzt.
